# GH Sales Lumber & Flooring

> Building materials and flooring in Nampa, Idaho, serving Boise and the surrounding Treasure Valley. Japanese Sugi cedar tongue and groove and boards, quality flooring at low prices, lumber, beams and fencing. Flooring and carpet installation available.

Pickup address: 1113 N 39th St, Nampa, ID 83687.

Products include luxury vinyl plank (LVP/SPC), waterproof laminate, hardwood and carpet; Japanese Sugi cedar; lumber and beams; fencing; decking; paneling, siding and trim; roofing; insulation; tile and stone; and other building materials. Inventory varies. Check current listings and confirm availability before making a trip.

In-stock flooring is ready to pick up, with limited quantities shown in each listing. Special-order flooring offers a wide selection of styles, ordered for the project, with matching transitions, stair nosing and trim available. Delivery is available for an added fee.

## Hours

Our hours vary, so please call or text ahead if you're making a special trip. Some days we're out for part or all of the day in the course of business.

- Monday: 11 AM to 6 PM
- Tuesday: 11 AM to 6 PM
- Wednesday: 11 AM to 3 PM
- Thursday: 11 AM to 6 PM
- Friday: 11 AM to 5:30 PM
- Saturday: Closed
- Sunday: By appointment
